prOriginal.nota: Found via head branch fix/round-robin-date-override (repo calcom/cal.com now redirects to calcom/cal.diy). PR's last commit is the benchmark head ee38fd2; squash commit 3ef3284 touches the same 4 files with identical line counts. Reverted by #8369 on 2023-04-19.

advanced-date-override-handling-and-time.reason: The buggy code (the dateOverrides/workingHours block added to checkIfIsAvailable in packages/trpc/server/routers/viewer/slots.ts) was merged upstream with #8330 on 2023-04-18, identical to the benchmark head. The next day #8369 reverted #8330 entirely with no stated reason, restoring the pre-PR code; the history of the file (later moved to viewer/slots/util.ts) and main today show the logic was never reintroduced. Removal by a whole-PR revert that targets no specific bug, so descontinuado.

astra.pergunta: Whole-PR revert (#8369, 2023-04-19, no stated reason) removed all code added by #8330 and it was never reintroduced: descontinuado or confirmado?
astra.resposta: First answer: confirmado, the revert restored prior behaviour and eliminated the bugs.

astra.pergunta: Counterpoint: descontinuado covers removal without a change targeting the bug; a reasonless whole-PR revert also removed the feature and targets no specific bug. Does that change the verdict?
astra.resposta: Yes: the revert removed the bug-carrying code, evidence does not show it targeted these bugs; removal alone is not a confirmed fix.
